answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 8666 Country: India Title: Who shoud qurbani? Question: Who shoud qurbani? Answer ID: 8666 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1417/1186=L/1429) One who is owing wealth equal to nisab has to offer Qurbani. In this nisab , the owned gold, silver, cash and belongings more than one?s needs, also will be counted i.e. if he or she owns such wealth equal in value to 612.36 g silver then it is wajib on him/her to offer Qurbani. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
